title: HongQi - HS9 VFX Campaign
description: Astroshot produced a bold VFX campaign for the Hongqi HS9 in Kuwait, designed to grab instant attention and spark conversation on social media. Filmed on Gulf Road, the concept showed two Hongqi HS9 cars driving smoothly side by side while a man in dishdasha stood balanced on a platform connecting both vehicles, dramatizing the car’s stability and smooth ride. The campaign generated over 100,000 organic views, making it a strong example of attention-driven automotive content in Kuwait.
